casting_note: Tier format: one male and one female identity each repeated three times, not a normal independent six-character cast.

figuren.name: Diakonin Nebenwirkung
figuren.signature: broad upright bell-shaped goo blob with little curled crown emerging beside tiny ivory linen cap, short pale-blue stole collar only, subtle lashes, ONE square upper tooth and a big lower fang. A thick brass spoon-shaped sun medallion is always at collar.
figuren.prompt_auszug: Worried drooping mouth, wide eyes watching hands. One hand holds small wooden healing MALLET with linen-padded head, other cradles a plain bandage roll.

figuren.name: Herr Mitnahme
